display_name: Eight citations and two date pairs around the National Health Insurance Law, 5754-1994, recorded as typed values with their tests: five defects (the defined term in reg 1(א) of the Reduced Rates Regulations, the words naming s 341 in s 14(ו1), two chapter letters in the Special Provisions and Exemption Regulations, and a Hebrew and a Gregorian date that name different days in the definition of an absence year in s 58) and their controls; not an encoding of the Law
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: the insured person and the person who pays the contributions for them; the row asks no question from the seat because it records references.

source.note: the three texts are unofficial consolidations; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are in amending-laws/ and official/ with their page images.

expected_red.note: five assertions about four defective citations: the term in reg 1(א) of the Reduced Rates Regulations, the words naming s 341 in s 14(ו1), chapter ג׳ in the Special Provisions Regulations, and chapter ו2 in the Exemption Regulations (two assertions); each states that the citation points at what its words say, or that the chapter stands under its name, and the texts quoted say otherwise; a sixth assertion states that the Hebrew date and the Gregorian date given for one day in Sefer HaChukim 1798 p. 433, s 1(1) (14 Adar 5761 and 1 March 2001) name the same day, and they do not (9 March 2001 and 1 March 2001)

run.method: one Sonnet encoder, from a written brief; the page images of the instruments were read by the encoder
